title: Navital Gym: Rule-Graded Agent Environments for Indian Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.20924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are being deployed on Indian workflows such as payments, tax, forms, travel and customer support in Hindi and Hinglish. Public agent evaluations rarely cover these workflows, and many score with another language model. We present Navital Gym, a set of six open environments with 321 public tasks in five task families: trip planning, UPI payments and disputes, GST invoicing and returns, form filling (including a multi-document split) and customer support in Hindi, Hinglish and three experimental Indian languages. Every task is graded by named, deterministic rules that recompute the outcome from a synthetic sandbox world. No language model judges any score. We report one run per task for three models on all six environments, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 4.5, and for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on two (UPI and the Support core). Opus solves 315 of 321 tasks, Sonnet 302 and Haiku 205. Trip planning and Hindi/Hinglis

translated_title: Navital Gym：面向印度工作流的规则评分智能体环境
translated_abstract: 人工智能智能体正被部署到印度的各类工作流中，例如用印地语和印地语-英语混合语（Hinglish）进行的支付、税务、表格填写、旅行和客户支持等。公开的智能体评测很少涵盖这些工作流，且许多评测使用另一个语言模型来打分。我们提出了 Navital Gym，这是一套包含六个开放环境的评测集，共有321个公开任务，涵盖五大任务类别：行程规划、UPI支付与争议处理、GST发票开具与报税、表格填写（包括多文档拆分场景）以及使用印地语、Hinglish和三种实验性印度语言的客户支持。每个任务都由明确命名的确定性规则进行评分，这些规则从合成沙盒世界中重新计算结果，没有任何语言模型参与打分。我们在全部六个环境中对三个模型各进行了一次每任务的测试，分别是 Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Claude Haiku 4.5，并对 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 在其中两个环境（UPI和客户支持核心）上进行了测试。Opus 完成了321个任务中的315个，Sonnet 完成302个，Haiku 完成205个。
tldr: 提出了Navital Gym——一套包含六个开放环境、321个任务的印度工作流智能体评测基准，覆盖行程规划、UPI支付、GST税务、表格填写和印地语/Hinglish客户支持等任务，并采用确定性规则而非语言模型评判来打分。
en_tdlr: Navital Gym is a benchmark of six open agent environments with 321 tasks for Indian workflows (trip planning, UPI payments, GST, form filling, and Hindi/Hinglish customer support), where every task is graded by deterministic rules instead of language model judges.
